capex_inputs.label: Decision rule
capex_inputs.value: Rule: reject if Base fails; approve outright only if Downside also passes; otherwise approve with a checkpoint. Downside NPV -$14.1m: with FPGA demand growth of 2% a year, demand never exceeds existing capacity, so only yield, scrap and savings benefits remain.

capex_inputs.label: Checkpoint
capex_inputs.value: Checkpoint: release the purchase order once trailing FPGA demand exceeds 0.94m good units a month (95% of current good-unit capacity at max utilization).
